params.name: Arpeggiator switch
params.desc: Turns the arpeggiator on or off

params.name: MIDI A channel
params.usage: 0~15: Sets the channel to 1-16; 16-127: sets MIDI channel A to All

params.name: MIDI B channel
params.usage: 0~15: Sets the channel to 1-16; 16-127: sets MIDI channel B to All

params.name: MIDI channel A CV
params.usage: 0: Note; 1: Velocity; 2: Modulation; 3-127: LFO (rate set by clock out)
params.desc: Sets what comes out of MIDI channel A's CV output

params.name: MIDI channel B CV
params.usage: 0: Note; 1: Velocity; 2: Modulation; 3-127: LFO (rate set-<TAP> PGM_A)
params.desc: Sets what comes out of MIDI channel B's CV output

params.name: MIDI channel A gate
params.usage: 0: Note on; 1: Velocity > 50%; 2: Mod wheel > 50%; 3-127: LFO
params.desc: Sets what comes out of MIDI channel A's gate output

params.name: MIDI channel B gate
params.usage: 0: Note on; 1: Velocity > 50%; 2: Mod wheel > 50%; 3-127: LFO
params.desc: Sets what comes out of MIDI channel B's gate output

params.name: Pitch bend scale A
params.desc: Sets the amount of bend on MIDI channel A, in semitones

params.name: Pitch bend scale B
params.desc: Sets the amount of bend on MIDI channel B, in semitones

params.name: Aftertouch scale A
params.desc: Sets the amount of aftertouch on MIDI channel A, in semitones

params.name: Aftertouch scale B
params.desc: Sets the amount of aftertouch on MIDI channel B, in semitones

params.name: Velocity scale A
params.desc: Sets the minimum velocity value for MIDI channel A

params.name: Velocity scale B
params.desc: Sets the minimum velocity value for MIDI channel B

params.name: MIDI block switch
params.desc: Turns the MIDI clock on or off

params.name: Tempo in divisor
params.desc: Divides the tempo in as reflected in clock out
